{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
cleaned_revenue = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = cleaned_revenue == 999999.99

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'

# Identify loyal customers
loyal_mask = sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'

# Combine: loyal AND completed AND NOT QA AND NOT refunded
# Note: completed and refunded are mutually exclusive, so we can use completed_mask
selection_mask = loyal_mask & completed_mask & ~qa_mask

# Filter data
filtered_data = sales[selection_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float).mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_revenue)"}
